claim: A longitudinal military cohort study reported a strong association between EBV infection and subsequent MS risk.
future_grounding_route: Use only as segregated EBV-MS risk context unless EBV-stratified immune-expression data with controls are acquired for project grounding.
project_use: External EBV-MS risk context for V49 review of the project's downgraded EBV/IFN APC imprint; not evidence for an APC/IFN imprint or specificity.

source.citation: Bjornevik et al. Longitudinal analysis reveals high prevalence of Epstein-Barr virus associated with multiple sclerosis. Science. 2022.
source.label: Science EBV-MS longitudinal cohort

why_unverifiable: The project does not hold or rerun the external military serum cohort and EBV-serology pipeline.
